details: Hopes for a 60-day extension of the US-Iran ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have emerged, easing geopolitical tensions. This development has contributed to a drop in oil prices and reportedly saw Bitcoin ticking upwards, despite ongoing institutional ETF outflows. The agreement is described as tentative and awaits formal approval.
title: US-Iran Ceasefire Hopes Boost Crypto, Oil Prices Fall

details: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the seizure of approximately $1 billion in Iranian cryptocurrency assets. This action is part of "Operation Economic Fury," an initiative aimed at disrupting Iran's ability to finance illicit activities and showcasing global efforts to combat the misuse of digital assets.
title: US Seizes $1 Billion in Iranian Crypto Assets Amid Economic Pressure

details: The European Central Bank has advised EU finance ministers to exercise caution regarding proposals for additional euro stablecoins, citing potential risks to bank lending and interest rate control. Concurrently, the Wall Street Journal highlighted that stablecoins, as "private money," present systemic risks reminiscent of historical private-money experiments, which could potentially trigger financial crises.
title: ECB Cautious on Euro Stablecoins, WSJ Raises Systemic Risk Concerns

details: President Donald Trump's expanding personal cryptocurrency holdings are reportedly creating political challenges, potentially hindering the progress of the "Clarity Act." This significant legislation, aimed at regulating digital assets, faces increased scrutiny due to conflict-of-interest concerns ahead of upcoming midterm elections.
title: Trump's Crypto Ventures Jeopardize Landmark US Stablecoin Legislation

details: A Reuters poll indicates that China's official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) is expected to remain at 50 for May, signaling stagnant factory activity. This lack of expansion in a major global economy could lead to dampened worldwide growth expectations, potentially influencing the dynamics of cryptocurrency markets.
title: China's Factory Activity Stalls in May, Dampening Global Growth Outlook
